state.decision: How the Editor lets a person animate a solid fill or stroke colour (row 11.132, frontend), on top of codex's released contract: timeline.colourChannels[] with createColourKey / updateColourKey / moveColourKey / removeColourKey, cmd_animation_surface.colourPropertyKinds (fill: rect, ellipse, text, shape; stroke: those plus line), interpolation in linear light, setPaint stays the static paint and never keys.
state.facts: Properties has no Fill or Stroke rows today: the colour shows only on the element card (Style: Colour #808080 · 100%) and is changed from the Library's colours (Apply as fill / stroke) or the Pen. Number rows in Properties have a keyframe diamond with previous and next arrows, and Auto-key decides whether a changed number gets a key. Timeline tracks are rows of diamonds; path keys (11.112) already ride the same rows with their own move, delete and easing edits. A colour has a source space (srgb, linear, display-p3, rec709) and every key of one track must share it. Gradients are not animatable by this contract.
state.constraints: One undoable command per gesture; the person and agents read the same rows (invariant 27); a value the contract refuses is not offered, it is dimmed with its reason.

rows.instructions: What do the Fill and Stroke rows in Properties look like?

criteria.A: A swatch and its hex (a colour picker on click), with the same keyframe diamond and previous / next arrows the number rows have; shown only for kinds the surface lists, dimmed with the reason when the paint is a gradient or none.
criteria.B: A hex text field only, no diamond; keys are made from the timeline.
criteria.C: Separate R, G, B and A number rows, each with its own diamond.

edit.instructions: What does changing the colour in the row do?

criteria.A: When the property already has colour keys, or Auto-key is on, it writes a key at the playhead (createColourKey, or updateColourKey when a key is there); otherwise it sets the static paint (setPaint). Same rule as the number rows.
criteria.B: Always sets the static paint; only the diamond makes keys.
criteria.C: Always writes a key at the playhead.

timeline.instructions: How do colour keys appear and behave in the timeline?

criteria.A: A track per keyed colour, labelled Fill colour / Stroke colour, its diamonds moved, deleted, staggered and eased with the same gestures as other keys (moveColourKey, removeColourKey, updateColourKey); the speed graph is not offered for them, with its reason.
criteria.C: Not shown in the timeline; only in Properties.
